description_html:
ABOUT SUPABASE

Supabase is the Postgres development platform, built by developers for developers. We provide a complete backend solution including Database, Auth, Storage, Edge Functions, Realtime, and Vector Search. All services are deeply integrated and designed for growth.



ABOUT THE ROLE

We’re looking for a Software Engineer to join our AI Tooling team and help shape how developers and agents build with Supabase. You'll build and own our AI tooling, including agents, the MCP server, agent skills and the dashboard assistant, and as the space moves you'll build the tooling for new technologies too. You'll build it all eval-first: every tool ships with evals and metrics, so we know, with evidence, that it makes agents better rather than worse.

You'll work closely with the Docs, CLI, Frontend and SDK teams, and with the AI Tooling Infrastructure engineers who run these services in production. Other teams contribute to AI Tooling to improve Supabase's agentic capabilities, and you'll help them do that while keeping the quality bar high.

This role is ideal for someone who thrives in async, fast-paced environments and is excited about building developer tools that scale to millions.



WHAT YOU’LL BE RESPONSIBLE FOR

 - Build and improve the AI tooling we run today, including the MCP server, agent skills, agents and the Assistant.

 - Make new Supabase products usable by agents from day one: tools, skills and evals for new product surfaces. Also build tooling for new AI technologies as they emerge: prototype quickly, evaluate honestly, and decide with the team what is worth taking to production.

 - Drive an eval-first approach: build and improve evals, instrumentation and feedback loops, measure tools against a no-tool baseline, and help define the quality KPIs and gates that stop regressions shipping.

 - Understand how customers and agents actually use what we ship, and turn that into improvements to our tooling, interfaces and documentation.

 - Design how documentation and product knowledge are exposed to agents, and measure whether it works.

 - Build patterns and tools that help customers add AI to their own apps, such as MCP on Edge Functions, vector embeddings and agents running on Edge Functions.

 - Enable teams to improve Supabase's agentic capabilities through contributions to AI Tooling: clear contribution paths, templates, documentation and review practice.

 - Centralise shared AI logic so teams reuse it rather than duplicate it.

 - Ship tools that are battle-tested, with strong tests, benchmarking and stress testing where it counts.

 - Work with the AI Tooling Infrastructure engineers on reliability, auth and hosting.

 - Work across Docs, CLI, Frontend, SDK and other teams to deliver one coherent developer experience, and stay close to the fast-moving AI ecosystem.
   


YOU MIGHT BE A GOOD FIT IF YOU



MUST HAVE:

 - Have 5+ years of experience in professional software engineering experience.

 - Write strong TypeScript and know the JavaScript ecosystem well: npm, ES modules, bundlers, compatibility.

 - Are deeply familiar with the AI ecosystem: current tools, agent patterns and practical trade-offs. You can tell a durable pattern from hype.

 - Have built developer tools, product interfaces or platform primitives used by other engineers.

 - Have designed or used evaluation frameworks to measure AI quality, reliability and task success, and understand baselines, variance and cost.

 - Have strong judgement about where AI improves workflows and how to avoid fragile or gimmicky experiences.

 - Write tests and validate reliability in real-world conditions.

 - Know Postgres and relational database practice.

 - Communicate clearly in writing, work across product, engineering and docs, and thrive in async, globally distributed teams.

 - Are comfortable navigating ambiguity and moving quickly.


NICE TO HAVE:

 - Experience with vector databases and embeddings, ideally pgvector.

 - Examples of customer-facing AI features or agents you've shipped.

 - Examples of documentation or structured knowledge designed for developers or agents.

 - Experience with Braintrust or a similar eval and tracing platform, or setting up CI quality gates.

 - Open-source contributions or developer tooling you've maintained.

 - Experience across several product surfaces or teams.


WHAT WE OFFER

 - Fully Remote
   
   We hire globally. We believe you can do your best work from anywhere. There are no Supabase offices, but we provide a WeWork membership or co-working allowance you can use anywhere in the world.

 - ESOP
   
   Every team member receives ESOP (equity ownership) in the company. We want everyone to share in the upside of what we’re building together.

 - Tech Allowance
   
   Use this budget to set up your ideal work environment—laptop, monitor, headphones, or whatever helps you do your best work.

 - Health Benefits
   
   Supabase covers 100% of health insurance for employees and 80% for dependents, wherever you are. Your wellbeing and your family’s health are important to us.

 - Annual Off-Sites
   
   Once a year, the entire company gathers in a new city for a week of connection, collaboration, and fun. It’s a highlight of our year.

 - Flexible Work
   
   We operate asynchronously and trust you to manage your own time. You know what needs to be done and when.

 - Professional Development
   
   Every team member receives an annual education allowance to spend on learning—courses, books, conferences, or anything that supports your growth.
   
   


ABOUT THE TEAM

Supabase was born-remote and open-source-first. We believe our globally distributed team is our secret weapon in building tools developers love.

 - ~400 team members

 - 60+ countries

 - 20+ languages spoken

 - Over $1B raised (including our $500M Series F)

 - 540,000+ community members

We move fast, build in public, and use what we ship. If it’s in your project, we probably use it in ours too. We believe deeply in the open-source ecosystem and strive to support—not replace—existing tools and communities.

title: AI Engineer, IT, AI Enablement
description_html: Our vision is to transform how the world uses information to enrich life for  all .    Micron Technology is a world leader in innovating memory and storage solutions that accelerate the transformation of information into intelligence, inspiring the world to learn, communicate and advance faster than ever.    Job Description   Join our AI Enablement team and help accelerate the adoption of Generative AI across the enterprise! In this role, you will  build and develop AI solutions that address real-world business challenges , improve efficiency, and create meaningful impact across diverse areas of our organization.  You will explore emerging technologies, craft rapid prototypes, automate processes, and integrate AI solutions with enterprise platforms. You will also collaborate with cross-functional teams to turn ideas into secure, scalable solutions while continuing to learn and innovate in a fast-evolving AI environment.     Responsibilities:    Build and develop AI solutions:  Craft AI-powered tools, agents, and automated workflows using technologies such as Microsoft Copilot Studio, UiPath, and other AI and automation frameworks.   Integrate enterprise technologies:  Connect AI solutions with Microsoft 365, SharePoint, external APIs, knowledge bases, and identity platforms to provide secure and efficient experiences.   Drive intelligent automation:  Identify opportunities for AI and automation, apply strong problem-solving skills, and develop solutions that improve productivity and business efficiency.   Collaborate and enable learning:  Partner with cross-functional teams to strengthen AI literacy, document best practices, collect feedback, and support learning and enablement activities.   Build secure and responsible AI:  Collaborate with cybersecurity and technology teams to incorporate data protection, authentication, authorization, threat modeling, AI governance, and responsible AI practices into solutions.    Minimum Qualifications:   Bachelor’s or master’s degree in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, Data Science, or a related technical field.  Experience developing software, AI/ML solutions, or intelligent automation, with proficiency in one or more languages such as  Python, C#, .NET, Java, SQL, PowerShell, or Unix shell scripting .  Understanding of  Generative AI, machine learning pipelines, APIs, and automation technologies , with the ability to apply these concepts to business challenges.  Experience or applied learning with technologies such as  Microsoft Copilot Studio, UiPath, SharePoint, or cloud AI platforms , including Microsoft Azure AI Foundry, Amazon Bedrock, or Google Vertex AI.  Knowledge of modern AI architectures and context-management approaches, including  retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), prompt engineering, semantic retrieval, agent-based systems, or Model Context Protocol (MCP) .    Preferred Qualifications:   Experience building or prototyping  Generative AI applications, AI agents, or intelligent automation solutions .  Knowledge of enterprise identity and access technologies such as  OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect (OIDC), SAML, or Microsoft Entra ID .  Interest in  AI governance, cybersecurity, data protection, and responsible AI practices .  Strong  interpersonal and collaboration skills , with an interest in learning from and working across technical and business teams.  Ability to adapt quickly, innovate, and deliver impactful solutions while considering enterprise security, scalability, and operational standards.              "The specified role does not encompass the following responsibilities: Finalization of sales agreements or the execution of sales contracts is prohibited. The role also does not carry the authority to make definitive decisions regarding contracts, be it their conclusion or termination. Furthermore, the role is not designed to involve participation in pricing negotiations or the authorization of contracts. These activities fall beyond the permissible duties of the position."        We are an industry leader in innovative memory and storage solutions transforming how the world uses information to enrich life for all. Every day, the innovations that our people create fuel the data economy, enabling advances in artificial intelligence and 5G applications that unleash opportunities — from the data center to the intelligent edge and across the client and mobile user experience. description_html: Job Requisition ID #                      26WD102129       Software Engineer, AI & Fusion Engineering (Entry Level)            Level:  Entry Level / Early Career     Location:  Novi, Michigan      Work Arrangement:     On-site (see Work Arrangement section below)      Team:      Fusion Engineering      About the Role           Autodesk is looking for an early-career Software Engineer who is excited about using artificial intelligence to change how products are designed and made. You'll join the Fusion engineering team in our Novi, Michigan office and help bring AI into Autodesk Fusion, our cloud-based platform for 3D CAD, CAM, CAE, and PCB design.          This role suits a recent graduate, or someone early in their career, who has hands-on experience with modern AI models and AI-assisted development tools, a solid engineering foundation, and an interest in working where AI, cloud services, and design and manufacturing software meet. You'll work alongside experienced engineers, product managers, and designers to build features that millions of engineers, designers, and manufacturers use every day.            What You'll Do           • Design, build, test, and maintain features for the Autodesk Fusion platform, with a focus on AI-driven capabilities.    • Integrate large language models and other AI models (for example, Anthropic Claude, OpenAI GPT, and open-source models) into Fusion workflows and services.    • Use AI coding assistants every day to speed up development, while keeping code quality, security, and maintainability high through review and testing.    • Prototype and evaluate AI solutions, including prompt design, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), agent workflows, and model evaluation, and turn successful prototypes into production features.    • Build and consume cloud-based web services and APIs (REST/GraphQL) that support Fusion's connected design and manufacturing experience.    • Work with Fusion's APIs and extensibility framework (Python and C++) to automate design workflows and extend platform functionality.    • Contribute to cloud infrastructure and deployment pipelines on platforms such as AWS or Azure.    • Write clean, well-tested, well-documented code, and take part in code reviews, design discussions, and agile ceremonies.    • Work with cross-functional teams in Novi and other Autodesk locations around the world.    • Keep up with the fast-moving AI landscape and share what you learn with the team.            Minimum Qualifications           • Bachelor of Science (BS) in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Computer Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related engineering discipline.    • Hands-on experience with AI technologies and models, through coursework, research, internships, or personal projects. Examples include building applications with LLM APIs such as Claude or GPT, prompt engineering, or fine-tuning and evaluating models.    • Working experience with AI-assisted development tools such as Cursor, Claude Desktop, Claude Code, or GitHub Copilot.    • Proficiency in at least one modern programming language, such as Python, C++, C#, TypeScript, or JavaScript.    • A solid grasp of software engineering fundamentals: data structures, algorithms, object-oriented design, and version control (Git).    • Strong problem-solving skills and eagerness to learn new technologies.    • Clear written and verbal communication, and the ability to work well in a team.            Preferred Qualifications           • Master's (MS) in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, Mechanical Engineering, or a related field.    • Experience with CAD/CAM/CAE software, ideally Autodesk Fusion, or exposure to the Fusion API.    • Experience with cloud development on AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud Platform, including serverless functions, containers (Docker, Kubernetes), and managed services.    • Experience building web services and RESTful or GraphQL APIs, including authentication, scalability, and performance.    • Familiarity with AI and ML frameworks and tooling such as PyTorch, TensorFlow, LangChain, LlamaIndex, Hugging Face, or vector databases.    • Experience with RAG pipelines, AI agents, the Model Context Protocol (MCP), or multi-model orchestration.    • Experience with spec-driven development (SDD): writing clear specifications, requirements, and acceptance criteria up front and using them to guide implementation, including AI agent workflows that generate, test, and check code against a specification.    • Understanding of responsible AI practices, including data privacy, model evaluation, bias mitigation, and safe deployment.    • Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, and DevOps practices.    • Background or interest in manufacturing, mechanical design, or the automotive industry.    • Internships, research publications, open-source contributions, or a portfolio of AI projects.            Work Arrangement           This position starts as fully on-site at Autodesk's Novi, Michigan office, so the new team member can onboard well, work closely with the team, and get mentoring in person. Later on, the role may become eligible for a hybrid arrangement, in line with Autodesk's workplace and flexible work guidelines. Hybrid eligibility depends on business needs, team requirements, and manager approval, and it is not guaranteed.            Why Join Us           • Meaningful impact: Help shape the  AI-powered future of design and manufacturing  on one of the industry's leading cloud CAD platforms.    • Growth and mentorship: Learn from experienced engineers, with structured onboarding and career development for early-career talent.    • Cutting-edge work: Work every day with the latest AI models and developer tools.    • Community: Join a collaborative engineering team in Novi that is rooted in Michigan's automotive and manufacturing heritage and works with customers across many industries worldwide, including aerospace, consumer products, industrial machinery, electronics, and architecture.    • Compensation and benefits: Competitive compensation and a comprehensive benefits package.              Learn More              About Autodesk    Welcome to Autodesk! Amazing things are created every day with our software – from the greenest buildings and cleanest cars to the smartest factories and biggest hit movies. We help innovators turn their ideas into reality, transforming not only how things are made, but what can be made.      We take great pride in our culture here at Autodesk – it’s at the core of everything we do. Our culture guides the way we work and treat each other, informs how we connect with customers and partners, and defines how we show up in the world.      When you’re an Autodesker, you can do meaningful work that helps build a better world designed and made for all. Ready to shape the world and your future? Join us!      Benefits   From health and financial benefits to time away and everyday wellness, we give Autodeskers the best, so they can do their best work. Learn more about our benefits in the U.S. by visiting    https://benefits.autodesk.com/                Salary transparency          Salary is one part of Autodesk’s competitive compensation package. For U.S.-based roles, we expect a starting base salary between $82,000 and $147,620. Offers are based on the candidate’s experience and geographic location, and may exceed this range. In addition to base salaries, our compensation package may include annual cash bonuses, commissions for sales roles, stock grants, and a comprehensive benefits package.     Equal Employment Opportunity     At Autodesk, we're building a diverse workplace and an inclusive culture to give more people the chance to imagine, design, and make a better world. Autodesk is proud to be an equal opportunity employer and considers all qualified applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status or any other legally protected characteristic. We also consider for employment all qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with applicable law.    Belonging   We take pride in cultivating a culture of belonging where everyone can thrive. Learn more here:    https://www.autodesk.com/company/global-belonging       In-Person Onboarding and Identity Verification   This role may require in-person onboarding and/or in-person ID verification.

title: Machine Learning Engineer 4 - Finance Tech
description_html: Machine Learning Engineer 4 - Finance Tech      Do you love building and pioneering in the AI and technology space? Do you enjoy solving complex business problems in a fast-paced, collaborative, inclusive, and iterative delivery environment? At Capital One, you'll be part of a big group of makers, breakers, doers and disruptors who love to solve real problems and meet real customer needs. We are seeking  Machine Learning Engineers  who are passionate about leveraging cutting-edge open source frameworks, advanced algorithms, and emerging technologies to join our team. As a Machine Learning Engineer, you’ll have the opportunity to be on the forefront of driving major AI transformations and scaling production models across Capital One.     Finance Tech is responsible for transforming Capital One's financial engine into the most trusted, nimble, and insightful in the industry. Our core mission is to engineer outcomes that strategically enable the Finance organization and the broader Enterprise to remain efficient. This mission is driven by four technical and functional pillars: Forecasting & Resiliency, providing advanced decision support; Treasury & Trade managing sophisticated cash and investment lifecycles; and Accounting & Reporting, ensuring the integrity of our general ledger and regulatory commitments. Powering these pillars are our Data and Core capabilities, which manage the orchestration, sourcing, and pipelines for critical financial data products.      By defining the next generation of financial technology, we ensure that every business process is backed by high fidelity tracking and reporting. Together, we are not just supporting the bottom line - we are building a strategic enabler that operates as a world class financial engine.      What You’ll Do:      The MLE role overlaps with many disciplines, such as Ops, Modeling, and Data Engineering. In this role, you'll be expected to perform many ML engineering activities, including one or more of the following:    Design, build, and/or deliver ML models and components that solve real-world business problems, while working in collaboration with the Product and Data Science teams    Inform your ML infrastructure decisions using your understanding of ML modeling techniques and issues, including choice of model, data, and feature selection, model training, hyperparameter tuning, dimensionality, bias/variance, and validation)    Solve complex problems by writing and testing application code, developing and validating ML models, and automating tests and deployment     Collaborate as part of a cross-functional Agile team to create and enhance software that enables state-of-the-art big data and ML applications    Retrain, maintain, and monitor models in production    Leverage or build cloud-based architectures, technologies, and/or platforms to deliver optimized ML models at scale    Construct optimized data pipelines to feed ML models    Leverage continuous integration and continuous deployment best practices, including test automation and monitoring, to ensure successful deployment of ML models and application code     Ensure all code is well-managed to reduce vulnerabilities, models are well-governed from a risk perspective, and the ML follows best practices in Responsible and Explainable AI    Use programming languages like Python, Scala, or Java      This role is designated as a hybrid position. You are expected to adhere to Capital One's hybrid policy regarding required on-site presence at your designated office location.      Basic Qualifications:      Bachelor's Degree or higher in Computer Science, Machine Learning or a related quantitative field (Statistics, Economics, Operations Research, Analytics, Mathematics, Engineering)    At least 4 years of experience programming with Python, Java, Golang, or C++    At least 4 years of Machine Learning experience using industry standard frameworks PyTorch or Tensorflow and libraries (Pandas, NumPy, Scikit-learn)    At least 4 years of experience using and operating large scale distributed systems (Spark, Ray) to prepare AI or Machine Learning data    At least 2 years of experience deploying and operating Machine Learning solutions in production and operating production services in the cloud (AWS, GCP, Azure) and using Kubernetes to manage large scale containerized Machine Learning software systems       Preferred Qualifications:      Master's or Doctoral Degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Mathematics, or related field    3+ years of experience optimizing ML algorithms, configurations, and infrastructure    3+ years of experience following software development best practices including source control, testing, code reviews, CI/CD, etc.     3+ years of experience building resilient software solutions with pre-production testing, advanced deployment techniques (one-box, blue/green, gradual dial-up), monitoring, alarms, and preparing incident response plans.    3+ years of experience working with Machine Learning techniques (Supervised, semi-supervised, and unsupervised, reinforcement learning, etc.) model types (Regression, Classification, Clustering, etc.), model Architectures (RNNs, CNNs, LSTMs, Transformers), training concepts (loss function, hyperparameters, regularization), and how to evaluate model accuracy and diagnose and address common issues (underfitting, overfitting)    3+ years of experience designing, implementing, and scaling production-ready data pipelines for training and evaluating ML models.    1+ years of experience as a technical lead developing ML solutions using industry best practices, patterns, and automation     Authored/co-authored a paper on a ML technique, model, or
